chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: The 1928 recording and the Gilded Kisses trio
summary: Corrects the record list: the trio on Gilded Kisses was Mosley, Stuff Smith and John Fielding.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: We worked it out. The band had amazing musicians. Just to think that early in life and nobody to listen to, it came naturally, it came natural with these guys. We worked that thing out. Sometimes I think back myself and wonder how we did it. On this first recording here in 1928, they made a little mistake here--
Gilded Kisses, John Fielding and unknown--who is unknown?
The Trio. I changed it here. In Gilded Kisses, I, Stuff Smith and John Fielding--that was the trio. Stuff did this alone--
